shows: With the manifest fix, the D2E8DA72 refusal is gone, including with CSV sources. CSV sources then fail with 3c242d89: the app requires extracts.
With Hyper extracts every rung opened: skeleton, Who and When, Pay, Reconciliation, dashboard, and the full data. No error dialog and no log event of severity error or fatal.
At full data the app ran one data query per sheet: Pay 25 rows, When 14, Who 25, Reconciliation 1. It logged 8 visual model updates and the soc_label filter domain (263 rows).

The same SQL, taken from the app log and re-run on the packaged extracts, gives the same row and column counts. Its Who, When and Pay results equal a separate DuckDB calculation over the CSV files, and its Reconciliation row equals the manifest and projection oracle.
does_not_show: Pixels, in this automated check: no screen was read. Screen Recording is not granted and Accessibility returned 0 windows. See user_check for the later look on screen.
That the values on screen equal the query results, beyond the app having run these queries.
Publishing: Save to Tableau Public was not tried. reconcile_public.py has not run because there is no public URL.
Interaction: filters and tabs were not operated.
internal_warnings_at_full_data: LazyConnect ConnectivityException at authentication stage for class hyper, before the connections that then succeeded.

UnknownColumn TEMP_NORM_(Calculation_8923543655999651066), logged as "Skipping the logical query cache"; that calculation is Certified rate on the Who sheet. The Who data query had already returned 25 rows and the sort query returned 25 after it. No dialog. Not investigated further.
Every quit needed SIGTERM after the 20 s graceful wait, including when nothing else was wrong. The reason was not established.

full_data_app_queries.sql:
SELECT "Extract"."metro_title" AS "metro_title",
  SUM("Extract"."lca_cases") AS "sum:lca_cases:ok",
  MAX("Extract"."oews_median") AS "usr:Calculation_1072832929630727379:ok",
  MAX("Extract"."lca_p50") AS "usr:Calculation_6121456055088610824:ok",
  MAX("Extract"."lca_p75") AS "usr:Calculation_6382079093195468333:ok",
  MAX("Extract"."lca_p90") AS "usr:Calculation_7896150639207011454:ok"
FROM "Extract"."Extract" "Extract"
WHERE (("Extract"."metro_top25" = 1) AND ("Extract"."soc_label" = '15-1252 Software Developers'))
GROUP BY 1

SELECT (CASE WHEN ("Extract"."received_month" < '2024-09') THEN '2024-08 or earlier' ELSE "Extract"."received_month" END) AS "Calculation_8934522910058655250",
  COUNT("Extract"."case_id") AS "usr:Calculation_3401231562416764474:ok"
FROM "Extract"."Extract" "Extract"
WHERE ("Extract"."fiscal_year" = 2025)
GROUP BY 1

SELECT "Extract"."soc_label" AS "soc_label"
FROM "Extract"."Extract" "Extract"
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY "soc_label" ASC NULLS FIRST

SELECT SUM("Extract"."is_certified") AS "TEMP(Calculation_8923543655999651066)(1792492237)(0)",
  COUNT("Extract"."case_id") AS "TEMP(Calculation_8923543655999651066)(603105487)(0)",
  "Extract"."employer_id" AS "employer_id",
  MEDIAN("Extract"."annual_wage") AS "usr:Calculation_5454371521732328664:ok"
FROM "Extract"."Extract" "Extract"
WHERE ("Extract"."data_role" = 1) AND EXISTS (
SELECT 1 AS "one"
FROM (
  SELECT "Extract"."employer_id" AS "employer_id",
    SUM("Extract"."data_role") AS "$__alias__0"
  FROM "Extract"."Extract" "Extract"
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY "$__alias__0" DESC NULLS LAST,
    "employer_id" ASC NULLS FIRST
  LIMIT 25
) "t0"
WHERE ("Extract"."employer_id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "t0"."employer_id")
)
GROUP BY 3

SELECT MAX((CASE WHEN (("Extract"."soc" = '15-1252') AND ("Extract"."area" = '1:99') AND ("Extract"."survey_year" = 2025)) THEN "Extract"."annual_median_wage" ELSE null::double precision END)) AS "TEMP(Calculation_3712301671509974071)(107307673)(0)",
  COUNT((CASE WHEN (("Extract"."soc" = '15-1252') AND ("Extract"."area" = '1:99') AND ("Extract"."survey_year" = 2025)) THEN "Extract"."annual_median_wage" ELSE null::double precision END)) AS "TEMP(Calculation_3712301671509974071)(2613515873)(0)",
  SUM("Extract"."is_certified") AS "TEMP(Calculation_7263587721379993760)(1792492237)(0)",
  COUNT("Extract"."case_id") AS "TEMP(Calculation_7263587721379993760)(603105487)(0)",
  "Extract"."snapshot_id" AS "snapshot_id",
  "Extract"."snapshot_kind" AS "snapshot_kind",
  COUNT(DISTINCT "Extract"."case_id") AS "usr:Calculation_1085837900395418063:ok",
  (PERCENTILE_CONT('0.75'::double precision) WITHIN GROUP (ORDER BY "Extract"."annual_wage" ASC)) AS "usr:Calculation_4825404769913467796:ok",
  SUM("Extract"."is_active") AS "usr:Calculation_5956792164354131971:ok"
FROM "Extract"."Extract" "Extract"
GROUP BY 5,
  6

SELECT "Extract"."employer_id" AS "employer_id",
  COUNT("Extract"."case_id") AS "usr:Calculation_3401231562416764474:ok"
FROM "Extract"."Extract" "Extract"
WHERE ("Extract"."data_role" = 1) AND EXISTS (
SELECT 1 AS "one"
FROM (
  SELECT "Extract"."employer_id" AS "employer_id",
    SUM("Extract"."data_role") AS "$__alias__0"
  FROM "Extract"."Extract" "Extract"
  GROUP BY 1
  ORDER BY "$__alias__0" DESC NULLS LAST,
    "employer_id" ASC NULLS FIRST
  LIMIT 25
) "t0"
WHERE ("Extract"."employer_id" IS NOT DISTINCT FROM "t0"."employer_id")
)
GROUP BY 1
